'''Rosa Muchnik de Lederkremer''' (born 12 January 1932) is an Argentine chemist. A doctor in chemical sciences, emeritus professor at the [[University of Buenos Aires]] (UBA), and senior researcher at the [[National Scientific and Technical Research Council]] (CONICET), she has received [[Konex Award]]s in the area of [[Organic chemistry|Organic Chemistry]] in 1983 and 2013. Her research includes major contributions in the area of [[glycobiology]] through investigating the inhibition of the key enzyme for the survival of ''[[Trypanosoma cruzi]]'' in the human body.<ref>{{Cite news |url=https://www.lanacion.com.ar/905243-un-derivado-de-la-lactosa-seria-util-contra-el-mal-de-chagas |title=Un derivado de la lactosa sería útil contra el mal de Chagas |trans-title=A Derivative of Lactose Could be Useful Against Chagas disease |first=Gabriel |last=Stekolschik |newspaper=[[La Nación]] |language=Spanish |date=2007-05-03 |access-date=2021-08-15}}</ref>

==Biography==
Rosa Muchnik was born in [[Buenos Aires]] on 12 January 1932, the daughter of Jewish immigrants from [[Ukraine]], who had to flee their homeland because of [[pogrom]]s and the rise of antisemitism in Europe. She is the firstborn of four siblings. When her father arrived in Argentina, he first settled in the town of [[Pigüé]], and shortly after saving money, he settled in Buenos Aires, where he met her mother.<ref name=Dulce>{{Cite journal |url=https://aargentinapciencias.org/wp-content/uploads/2018/01/Resenas/R-tomo2-3/Rese%C3%B1aT2N3.pdf |title=Media Centuria Dedicada a la Química Dulce |trans-title=Half a Century Dedicated to Sweet Chemistry |first=Rosa Muchnik de |last=Lederkremer |journal=Reseñas |publisher=Argentine Association for the Progress of the Sciences |volume=2 |number=3 |pages=82–93 |issn=2314-3134 |language=Spanish |year=2014 |access-date=2021-08-15}}</ref>

Rosa Muchnik was married to Gerardo Lederkremer from 1960 until his death in 2018.<ref name=Dulce/>

==Career==
Muchnik earned a [[Licentiate (degree)#Argentina|licentiate]] in chemical sciences from the UBA Faculty of Exact and Natural Sciences (UBA-FCEN) in 1954, and a doctorate in organic chemistry there in 1956. She completed a scholarship for further training at the [[Ohio State University]], together with Dr. [[Melville Wolfrom|M. L. Wolfrom]], from 1962 to 1965, and received a grant from the {{ill|Fundação de Amparo a Pesquisa do Estado de São Paulo|pt}} to elucidate the [[glycoprotein]] structure of ''[[Trypanosoma cruzi]]'' in 1977.

She became the first female professor of the Organic Chemistry Department (DQO UBA-FCEN) in 1967. She later served as its director from 1995 to 1999.<ref name=Konex>{{Cite web |url=http://www.fundacionkonex.org/b405-rosa-muchnik-de-lederkremer |title=Rosa Muchnik de Lederkremer |publisher=[[Konex Foundation]] |language=Spanish |access-date=2021-08-15}}</ref> She was the main impetus for the creation of [[National Scientific and Technical Research Council|CONICET]]'s Carbohydrate Research Center, and was its first director from 1995 to 2000.<ref name=Konex/><ref name=Semblanza>{{Cite journal |url=https://aargentinapciencias.org/wp-content/uploads/2018/01/Resenas/R-tomo2-3/Rese%C3%B1aT2N3.pdf |title=Rosa Muchnik de Lederkremer |journal=Reseñas |publisher=Argentine Association for the Progress of the Sciences |volume=2 |number=3 |pages=80–81 |issn=2314-3134 |language=Spanish |year=2014 |access-date=2021-08-15}}</ref>

==Awards and distinctions==
* 1983: [[Konex Award|Konex Merit Diploma]] in Organic Chemistry<ref name=Konex/>
* 2000: Dr. Venancio Deulofeu Award, Argentine Chemical Association<ref>{{Cite web |url=https://www.aqa.org.ar/images/premios/deulofeu.pdf |title=Investigadores galardonados con el 'Premio Dr. Venancio Deulofeu' |trans-title=Researchers Honored With the 'Dr. Venancio Deulofeu Award' |publisher=Argentine Chemical Association |language=Spanish |access-date=2021-08-15}}</ref>
* 2003: [[Bernardo Houssay Award|Bernardo Houssay Career Award]]<ref>{{Cite news |url=https://www.eldia.com/nota/2004-10-22-premios-houssay-a-la-investigacion-para-platenses |title=Premios Houssay a la investigación para platenses |trans-title=Houssay Research Awards for La Plata |newspaper=[[El Día (La Plata)|El Día]] |language=Spanish |date=2004-10-22 |access-date=2021-08-15}}</ref>
* 2008: Consecration Award from the National Academy of Exact and Natural Sciences<ref name=Semblanza/>
* 2013: Konex Platinum Award<ref name=Konex/>
